tests_added.instructions: The diff adds or changes a test that exercises the behaviour the diff changes.

criteria.true: A test file in the diff calls or drives the changed code path.
criteria.false: No test file changes, or only tests unrelated to the changed code change.

tests_pass.instructions: The test output shows the whole test run passing.

criteria.true: The run ends with every test passing and no failure, error or skipped suite reported.
criteria.false: Any failure, error or skipped suite is reported, the run was cut short, or there is no test output.

no_debug_left.instructions: The diff leaves no debugging code behind.

criteria.true: The added lines contain no console or print logging meant for debugging, no commented-out code, no debugger statements and no TODO or FIXME markers.
criteria.false: The added lines include any of those.
